provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 205 S CASTELL AVE, NEW BRAUNFELS, TX, 78130

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: An employee took an online CPR course which is not allowed, and the card did not specify whether first-aid was taught.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: During the investigation, it was determined that the operation does not practice lock-down drills regularly as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: During the investigation, it was determined that the Emergency Preparedness Plan did not include procedures for reunification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: During the investigation, it was determined that the emergency drills practiced in 2026 were not differentiated by type and were documented improperly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During the investigation, it was determined that one of the staff members did not have Emergency Preparedness training. Another staff's training was unavailable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: During the investigation, it was determined that the Emergency Preparedness Plan did not include evacuation methods for children under 24 months and staff responsibilities during an emergency situation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: During the investigation, it was determined that the Emergency Preparedness Plan did not include how staff should ensure the continuity of care during an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures: During the investigation, it was determined that the Emergency Preparedness Plan did not include the procedure for contacting CCR in the event of an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(2))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: During the investigation, the operation's Emergency Preparedness Plan was found to be incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Several employees took an online CPR course which is not allowed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: A cot was blocking the exit door during naptime.  This was correct when the caregiver moved the child and the cot away from the door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know how many children she was responsible for at the time of the inspection.  She had to count the children before being able to give a number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Several medications were found to be expired.  This was corrected when the medication was discarded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids: During the investigation, it was found that staff members did not wear gloves when handling an injury that involved blood.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3425(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The 4 year old room was observed with the tv on during lunchtime.  It is unknown how long the tv was on before entering the room.  This was corrected when the teacher turned the tv off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child: A caregiver turned away from the diaper changing table to throw away a diaper without having an infant secured with safety straps or a hand on a 10-month-old infant during the diaper change. This resulted in the 10-month-old falling off the changing table onto the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: An eleven month old infant was in the crib wearing a bib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Several bottles were observed with the first name and no last initial.  This was corrected when the bottles were labeled correctly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two children were not buckled in during lunch time due to the bucket seats not having any seatbelts. This was corrected when a new seatbelt was found and another one ordered and the bucket seats removed until the seatbelts get put on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A fire drill was not conducted for the months of November and December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was using a cell phone to create Tik Tok videos while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver was engaged in social media activity while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A plastic container in a 4-year-old room that holds toys was damaged, leaving rough edges that could pose a risk to children.  This was corrected when the container was replaced.    Rain gutters with sharp edges located on the playground were exposed to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Several rooms had peeling paint on the wall exposed to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: An incident report form was not used during an incident that involved the safety of children.  Parents were informed about the incident via phone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: A child was served an identified food that was listed on the child's food allergy emergency plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the information gathered from interviews, a teacher was heard using a yelling unpleasant type of tone with a child in the classroom.  According to the information gathered during interviews the same teacher was heard humiliating a child in front of the other children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The monthly maintenance checklist was last recorded in May.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Several purses were observed in rooms that were accessible to children.  This was CORRECTED when the purses were placed in a locked cabinet or up high.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two children's medication was found to be expired. This was corrected when the medication was set aside to return to parents at pick-up time.       This was corrected when they were removed by the director to return to parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The gas leak test was due in March 2024, and the last one was conducted on March 6, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The incident report was shared with the parent verbally, but it was not signed within the 48-hour timeframe.  The incident occurred on 10/7, and the report was signed on 10/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff was hired in March of 2023 and has been working in the operation without receiving the eligibility notification from the background check unit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Three out of ten children were missing a special needs statement.  This was corrected when the director updated the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: The daily buildings and grounds checklist was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The last time the fire extinguishers were serviced was in November 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: There was one child's medication missing a medication authorization from signed by a parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two children's medication was found to be expired and one child was withdrawn from the center.  This was corrected when the medication was set aside to return to parents at pick-up time and the other one was discarded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: A two-year room was observed serving snack on a bare table.  This was corrected when the caregivers were made aware and paper towels were given to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was conducted on 11/18/21. Fire inspections are due annually.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the information gathered from interviews, a caregiver was heard using a yelling unpleasant type of tone with the children while in the classroom.  The caregiver was also using a method of time-out by having the children face the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed in the infant room with direct access to children without receiving an eligibility letter from the background unit.  This was corrected when the caregiver was removed out of the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: One teacher working in the infant room had an expired SIDS training.  This was corrected when the director had the staff complete the training during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two expired medications were observed.  This was corrected when the director left them out to return to the parents at pick-up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two outlet covers were observed to be cracked and one was sharp to the touch.  This was corrected when the outlet covers were replaced.    Chip paint was observed on the wall in two rooms.  This was corrected when maintenance was called to do the repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.  This was corrected when it was added during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
